statement.excerpt: In 2025, a lot of AI influencers and maybe some companies are going to claim we have reached AGI.
statement.document_title: o3, AGI, the art of the demo, and what you can expect in 2025

our_interpretation: Count distinct public commentators with an established audience discussing AI, rather than repeated statements by one person.
The statement must affirm that AGI already exists. Future predictions, questions and reports of someone else's claim do not qualify.
A lot means numerous distinct claimants, beyond a few isolated examples. Marcus supplied no numerical threshold.
Maybe some companies is optional and is not a separate requirement.
Only statements made during calendar 2025 count, although the forecast horizon begins on the post date.
criteria.support_condition: A documented collection establishes numerous distinct influential AI commentators affirming during 2025 that AGI had already been reached.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive record establishes that such declarations were absent or confined to isolated cases.
